data.name: CodeGen_Error_MultiTargetEfCoreExclusive
data.value: EF Core generation cannot be combined with multi-target QuickER Repositories (two or more effective dialects). Narrow it to a single dialect or disable EF Core (the two are mutually exclusive).

data.name: CodeGen_Error_InMemoryRuntimePackagesExclusive
data.value: In-memory Repository generation cannot be combined with the runtime package reference mode (UseRuntimePackages). The in-memory executor is emitted as fixed code on the generated side, so in a package reference mode that does not emit fixed code it loses its reference target. Disable UseRuntimePackages (emit the fixed code inline) or disable in-memory generation.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_TypeMismatch
data.value: Column '{1}' of table '{0}' resolves to different C# types across dialects ({2}: {3} / {4}: {5}). The shared Entity is a single type, so both dialects must resolve to the same C# type.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_MapperRequiresEntityAndEditModel
data.value: Generating a Mapper requires both the Entity class and the EditModel class. Include both as generation targets.

data.name: CodeGen_Error_RepositoryRequiresDataAnnotations
data.value: Repository / EF Core / in-memory Repository use the [Table] / [Key] / [Column] attributes, so data annotations must be applied. Enable data annotations.
